title: Minerva Restaurant At Passage 771, House 15 Avenue Joffre

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE
D. REGISTRY
C.S.6, Special Branch
REPORT
Date June 21, 1938.

Subject "Minerva" Restaurant at Passage 771, House 15, Avenue Joffre.

Made by D.S.I. Medvedeff, Forwarded by Inspector

B.J. MEDOVY alias Boris Yankelevich MEDOVOY,
Russian Jew, C.R.O. F-1826 and Shep. el Naumovich PERZOVSKY,
alias PENTZOVSKY, nicknamed SAMSON, Russian Jew, C.R.O. F-64,
are operating a small restaurant named "Minerva" at Passage
771, House 15, Avenue Joffre. The licence has been issued
in the name of Medovoy. Perzovsky has been previously
charged with shop-breaking and is now detained by the French
Police in connection with the case of Serousoff, C.R.O.F-74,
who was arrested on 17-6-38 for possession of arms and ammuni-
tion.

Mihail Litvinsky, Russian Jew, C.R.O. F-101 is also
employed in the restaurant as a waiter and general assistant.
Litvinsky is a professional thief and shop-lifter.

N. Medvedeff
D. S. I.

报告
日期：1938年6月21日。

事由：霞飞路771弄15号“密涅瓦”（Minerva）餐馆。

由特别股督察梅德韦杰夫（Medvedeff）撰写，经督察转发

B.J. 梅多维（MEDOVY），又名鲍里斯·扬克列维奇·梅多沃伊（Boris Yankelevich MEDOVOY），
俄籍犹太人，刑事登记处编号 F-1826，以及谢普塞尔·瑙莫维奇·佩尔佐夫斯基（Shep. el Naumovich PERZOVSKY），
又名彭特佐夫斯基（PENTZOVSKY），绰号萨姆森（SAMSON），俄籍犹太人，刑事登记处编号 F-64，
正在霞飞路771弄15号经营一家名为“密涅瓦”的小餐馆。营业执照是以梅多维的名义签发的。佩尔佐夫斯基此前曾因破门盗窃被起诉，目前因涉及塞鲁索夫（Serousoff，刑事登记处编号 F-74）一案被法国警察拘留，塞鲁索夫于1938年6月17日因持有武器和弹药被捕。

米哈伊尔·利特温斯基（Mihail Litvinsky），俄籍犹太人，刑事登记处编号 F-101，也受雇于该餐馆，担任侍者及杂务助理。
利特温斯基是一名职业窃贼和商店扒手。

page_data.en:
Russ Desperado
Held By Police
In Frenchtown

Mikail Serousov, 46, Russian
emigre desperado with a criminal
record dating back to his 'teens is
again in the hands of the police.
He was arrested Saturday night by
Detective-Sergeant K. A. Slobod-
chikoff of the French Police for
being in possession of firearms.
Serouscv is perhaps best known
to old residents of Shanghai as one
of a gang of six emigre bandits
who attempted to kidnap Messrs
Arthur and Theodore Sopher here
approximately nine years ago. At
that time the attempted kidnapping
was frustrated, and all six were
convicted. Serousov drew three
years in jail for his share in the
conspiracy.
Since his release, he has been
convicted again on a charge of
burglary and housebreaking.
At the time of his arrest last
Saturday, a .38 caliber Mauser and
several rounds of ammunition were
found in his possession.
page_data.zh:
俄籍亡命之徒
被警方羁押
在法租界

米哈伊尔·谢鲁索夫（Mikail Serousov），46岁，俄籍流亡亡命之徒，其犯罪记录可追溯至其青少年时期，再次落入警方手中。他于上周六晚被法国警察警长K. A. 斯洛博德奇科夫（K. A. Slobodchikoff）逮捕，原因是持有枪支。对于上海的老居民来说，谢鲁索夫或许最为人所知的身份是九年前在此地企图绑架阿瑟·索费尔（Arthur Sopher）和西奥多·索费尔（Theodore Sopher）两位先生的六人流亡匪帮成员之一。当时，绑架未遂，六人全部被判有罪。谢鲁索夫因参与该阴谋被判入狱三年。
自获释以来，他再次因入室盗窃和破门盗窃罪名被定罪。
在上周六被捕时，警方在其身上搜出一支.38口径毛瑟手枪及数发子弹。
